ownershipLimits: Counters measure application references/handle calls, not native heaps, OS threads, browser decoding memory, actual file saves or audio quality.
Object URL/audio APIs and workers are injected. No browser, audible playback, speech service, model download or inference was used.

Chapter/previews intentionally retain one URL while loaded; successful downloads retain URLs until their release timers. Harness teardown releases loaded URLs; no claim of a new application-wide destroy API.
Panels install DOM listeners once at application setup. Cancelling an operation is not panel destruction; no per-cycle listener installation was observed in the audited paths.
Pagehide/BFCache behavior and browser-managed document URL release remain unverified. Existing pagehide handlers cancel operations and speech; this change does not promise complete native teardown.
Existing browser-timer/watchdog and failed worker-send tests also run in the full suite; no native cleanup guarantee is inferred.
